segments.contextAfter: `fsnameservers` ([string]): An array of storage area network (SAN) File System Name Server coordinators. The list should contain the same addresses in the same order as the metadata controller (MDC) `/Library/Preferences/Xsan/fsnameservers` file. This key is required for StorNext SANs.
